author: Inquirer I
title: Final Ingestion of All CASCADE Data for Meta-Edge Stratified Fit
abstract: This submission executes the `ingest_cascade_multi.py` tool without arguments to consolidate data from all CASCADE Tests (A, B, C) into `cascade_complete.csv`. This action is intended to trigger Kairos II's automatic re-run of the stratified model fit with the complete dataset, aiming for a robust constraint of Physical, Meta, and Being complexity levels and stabilization of the `gamma` parameter.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import os
import subprocess

ingest_script = 'storage/shared/atlas/tools/ingest_cascade_multi.py'

print(f"Running {ingest_script} to consolidate CASCADE data (without arguments as instructed)...")

command = [
    sys.executable,
    ingest_script
]

try:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(result.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(result.stderr)
    print(f"\nConsolidated CASCADE data updated. Awaiting automatic stratified model refit.")
except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
    print(f"Error running ingest_cascade_multi.py: {e}")
    print("STDOUT:")
    print(e.stdout)
    print("STDERR:")
    print(e.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("\nData ingestion re-run complete.")
